newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-HOUSTON CONFIRMED AS NEW QPR MANAGER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HOUSTON CONFIRMED AS NEW QPR MANAGER.

text.p: Stewart Houston was appointed manager of Queens Park Rangers on Monday just three days after quitting as caretaker manager of Arsenal.
Houston succeeds former England midfielder Ray Wilkins at the first division club, fulfilling hsis wish to become a manager in his own right after six years as assistant at Highbury.

The 47-year-old Scot spurned the chance to become assistant to incoming Arsenal manager Arsene Wenger and was also linked with renewing his successful Highbury partnership with George Graham at Leeds.

But Houston, a member of the Manchester United team beaten in the 1976 F.A. Cup Final by Southampton, has instead opted to move across London and try and take QPR straight back into the premier league following their relegation last season.
Houston had two spells as caretaker manager at Arsenal, and during the first guided them to the 1995 European Cup Winners Cup Final which they lost to Real Zaragoza in the last minute of extra time.
